fact: The Egyptian Tax Authority head said at Cairo ICT 2026 that AI is used to analyse its database of about 4 billion electronic invoices and receipts and to sort taxpayers' proposals, alongside a new real-estate tax app using AI.
title: مصلحة الضرائب المصرية تستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي لتحليل 4 مليارات مستند
